key_highlights: ASX slumps sharply as miners and banks sell off; oil hovers near US$100/bbl amid Trump's Iran conflict
US 10Y yield nears two-decade high, pressuring global risk assets and rate-sensitive ASX sectors
WA gold sector sees unprecedented M&A and exploration activity (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway)
Copper surges as Flagship ups Canadian stakes; critical mineral prices boom for solar-panel inputs
Austal jumps on US$1.9b acquisition bid; Inpex audit confirms emissions rectification progress
Australian housing: high-end prices hit by steepest falls while affordable segment remains resilient
Power giant proposes AI data centres at retired coal plant sites, signalling energy transition pivot

sectors.trend: Mixed: gold and copper sub-sectors strong on WA discoveries and global metal prices, but broad mining index dragged lower by oil-driven risk-off and bank weakness. Critical mineral prices surging.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX, FOR.AX) and copper names (CPL.AX, FGP.AX) offer relative strength. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from risk-off sentiment despite commodity fundamentals.

sectors.trend: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX sharply lower as rising 10Y yields and oil-driven inflation fears pressure equity valuations. Credit conditions tightening.
sectors.implications: Short-term headwind from rate sensitivity; however, higher yields may support NIMs medium-term. Monitor RBA response to imported inflation from US$100 oil.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100/bbl on Iran conflict; Inpex (INPX.AX) audit clears emissions concerns. Power giant pivoting coal sites to AI data centres. WA energy policy under political scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Positive for LNG producers (WDS.AX, GSO.AX) and oil-exposed names. Coal-to-data-centre transition creates new infrastructure plays. Inpex de-risked post-audit.

sectors.trend: High-end property prices falling sharply; affordable housing resilient. Stan secures EPL in US$800m deal. Apple raises iPhone pricing globally.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals—premium segment weak, mass-market stable. Media/tech consumer (W1.AX) benefits from content lock-in. Consumer staples defensive.

sectors.trend: Austal (AST.AX) jumps on US$1.9b bid. AI infrastructure theme strong globally (Lumentum, data centres). Critical mineral supply chains expanding.
sectors.implications: Austal M&A signals consolidation in shipbuilding/defence. AI data-centre buildout supports electrical and infrastructure names (SGH.AX, INC.AX).

key_themes: Oil at US$100/bbl from Iran conflict drives inflation fears and risk-off globally
US 10Y yield near two-decade high pressures all rate-sensitive ASX sectors
WA gold rush: multiple high-grade discoveries and M&A activity
Copper and critical mineral supercycle accelerating
Australian housing bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
Energy transition: coal sites repurposed for AI data centres
Trump trade/geopolitical risk as persistent overhang

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil at US$100/bbl and Iran conflict escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic LNG (WDS.AX) over oil importers; monitor AUD/USD for imported inflation pass-through

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US 10Y yield near two-decade high; RBA forced to hold or hike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in REITs and growth equities; favour short-duration financials and cash yields

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASX broad-based sell-off in miners and banks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Selective positioning in gold/copper over diversified miners; avoid leverage

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Australian housing correction in premium segment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight premium REITs; favour affordable-housing and construction plays

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical spillover from Trump's Iran war on global risk appetite
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain 10-15% cash allocation; use gold (GOLD.AX) as hedge

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold producers and explorers
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon, Gateway US$45M) signal sector upcycle; gold benefits from geopolitical risk and yield uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper and critical mineral exposure
opportunities.rationale: Copper surging globally; critical mineral for solar panels in price boom; Flagship expanding Canadian position signals supply tightness

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Austal on M&A premium
opportunities.rationale: US$1.9b bid creates near-term upside; defence/shipbuilding secular tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Favour domestic LNG over oil-exposed names
opportunities.rationale: Inpex audit clears overhang; LNG contracts insulated from spot oil volatility; WDS long-term offtake provides stability

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to broad diversified miners and banks
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX slumping on risk-off; oil-driven inflation may force RBA hawkish hold, pressuring rate-sensitive financials

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight premium REITs; favour consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: High-end property correction underway; staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) offer defensive income in volatile environment
Oil at US$100 and 10Y yield spike create volatility; preserve capital for potential ASX pullback entry

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months as oil near US$100 sustains inflation fears, 10Y yields stay elevated, and RBA signals hawkish hold. Gold and copper sub-sectors outperform; banks and diversified miners lag. Expect 3-5% volatility in ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if Iran conflict de-escalates and oil normalises below US$85. WA gold/copper cycle supports materials sector. Housing bifurcation stabilises. AI data-centre buildout and critical minerals create structural growth pockets. RBA likely to cut 25-50bp by H2 2026 if inflation eases.
key_catalysts: RBA September/November rate decision and statement
Oil price trajectory and Iran conflict resolution
US 10Y yield direction and global risk sentiment
WA gold production ramp-up (Auric, Gateway, Golden Dragon)
Austal M&A completion and defence order book
Australian CPI print (imported inflation from oil)
AUD/USD reaction to commodity and yield moves
watch_list: Iron ore and copper LME prices
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Australian housing price index (premium vs affordable split)
Inpex LNG production and contract renewals
Trump trade policy and tariff announcements
